Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity. Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career.  Job Description You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry. As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

• Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
• Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
• Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
• Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
• Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
• Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
• Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends
Profile

• MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
• Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
• Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
• Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
• Good communication skills in English
• A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
• Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation
Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.

 Employment Conditions

• Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
• Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
• Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
• The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
• Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
• Vacancy number: 27390
Important Notice Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applications from candidates who require sponsorship or who do not meet the work authorization requirements will not be considered

jobs.occupation: Maintenance Technician – Relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands
jobs.description: Start your technical career in the Netherlands Are you an experienced Maintenance Technician based in Portugal and ready for an international step in your career? Xelvin is looking for motivated technical professionals who want to relocate to the Netherlands and work in industrial maintenance, production technology or technical service environments. In this role, you will work as part of a technical department and help keep machines, production lines and installations running smoothly. You will solve technical issues, carry out preventive maintenance and contribute to a safe, reliable and efficient production process. This position is suitable for technicians with experience in industrial maintenance, mechanics, electromechanics, automation or technical service. What you will do As a Maintenance Technician, you are responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving technical installations and production equipment. You will work in a practical, hands-on environment where no two days are the same. Your responsibilities may include: Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on machines, production lines and technical installations. Diagnosing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic or hydraulic faults. Repairing and replacing machine parts, sensors, motors, pumps, conveyors or other technical components. Supporting production teams when technical problems occur. Carrying out inspections and basic testing of equipment. Reading and using technical drawings, electrical diagrams or machine documentation. Registering maintenance activities and technical findings. Thinking along about improvements in reliability, safety and efficiency. Working according to safety standards and company procedures. Cooperating with colleagues from production, engineering and technical service. Depending on your experience, the role can be more mechanically, electrically or electromechanically focused. What Xelvin offers you Relocating to another country is a big step. Xelvin supports youthroughout the process, from the first interview to your first working day in the Netherlands. We offer: A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A competitive gross monthly salary between €2,800 and €4,200, depending on your experience, technical background and the type of company. Possible shift allowance, depending on the working schedule and production environment. 25 paid holidays, in addition to Dutch public holidays. 8.33% holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Support with your relocation from Portugal to the Netherlands. Assistance with documentation needed to work in the Netherlands. Guidance from our housing consultant in finding accommodation. Support during onboarding and your first period in the Netherlands. Personal guidance from Xelvin. Opportunities for training, courses and career development. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for practical technicians with a solid technical education and hands-on experience in an industrial environment. You have: A technical education such as Curso Técnico Profissional / Nível 4 or higher in one of the following areas: Mecatrónica Manutenção Industrial Eletromecânica Eletrotecnia Automação Mecânica Industrial Technology or similar At least 2 years of experience in industrial maintenance, technical service, production maintenance or machine maintenance. Good mechanical and/or electrical troubleshooting skills. Experience with industrial equipment, production lines, machinery or automated systems. Basic knowledge of electrical, mechanical, pneumatic or hydraulic systems. The ability to read technical drawings or electrical schematics is a strong advantage. Experience with PLC-controlled machinery is a plus, but not always required. A practical, hands-on mindset. A safe and responsible way of working. Willingness to work in shifts, depending on the company and production environment. Good communication skills in English. Motivation to relocate from Portugal to

Even though many people in the Maastricht Region speak English with varied proficiency, employers still often ask for Dutch at a certain level. Internationals often have great soft skills, such as flexibility and perseverance. These are very valuable, but they are not enough on their own. Employers also want to see clear, practical skills. Fellowship in Paintings Conservation SRAL is offering a fellowship (full-time, 40h) in the Paintings Conservation Department. The one-year fellowship will commence on May 1st, 2027 and include a monthly stipend of €2850,- gross. SRAL Fellowship in Paintings Conservation Working under the guidance of the SRAL conservators the fellow will focus on practical conservation and restoration treatments as well as on a research project. The fellow will work as part of the team and participate in the daily activities of the conservation studio, focusing on easel paintings on canvas and possibly panel. Also, they may have the opportunity to join conservation work on site. The intern will carry out a range of conservation treatments including technical examination, photographic as well as written documentation. They also will be encouraged to participate in the decision-making processes. Participation in workshops, lectures and occasional studio visits will contribute to the fellowship programme. Although the research project's initial outline will be provided by SRAL conservators, its ultimate direction and scope will be decided in close consultation with the fellow. Eligibility Applicants hold a master's degree in conservation. They should have a maximum of two years of professional experience post-graduation. Candidates are responsible for securing visas and other permits for their stay and work in the Netherlands. (SRAL is not a registered sponsor at IND). As an operator, you’ll work in the hub of an innovative recycling company that transforms old foam materials into new end products such as carpet underlays and insulation panels. The products are dismantled at other locations, and the recycled material is returned to the Alphen aan den Rijn site as large foam blocks (up to 5,500 kilos each). That’s where your work begins. You’ll be responsible for operating various machines in the production line, including the flake mill, mixing chamber, pouring cylinder, and laminating machine. You’ll feed the machines with recycled foam, set them correctly, and monitor the process closely. By following instructions accurately, you help ensure the quality of the final product. You’ll also handle the timely supply of raw materials and semi-finished products using a forklift. No forklift certificate yet? No problem, you can obtain it through Luba.The company works with two shifts, but you will only work the evening shift, from 15:00 to 00:00. As the company is growing rapidly, the work environment is dynamic and developing. The day shift currently consists of 15 employees, while the evening shift has just 3. You will be part of the growing evening shift, which will eventually expand to a team of around 15 people, with all five machines operating, just like during the day shift.During the process, the foam is shredded, glued, steamed, and laminated. You make sure the right materials are available, machines are running properly, and you take action when needed. You work carefully and keep your workplace clean and safe. Together with your colleagues, you ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently. Working hours are from 14.45-2345., with an evening shift allowance starting from 19:00.- Physically fit, eager to learn, and precise- You speak Dutch or fluently English- Responsible and tidy worker- Forklift certificate or willing to obtain one through Luba- Willing to work from 14.45-2345.

jobs.occupation: PhD epidemiology of kidney replacement therapy in Europe
jobs.description: We are looking for an enthusiastic PhD _tudent to perform epidemiological research on patients treated by dialysis or kidney transplantation in an international environment. You will conduct epidemiological research on patients receiving kidney replacement therapy across European countries, investigating its occurrence, patient characteristics, and clinical outcomes. By expanding our database with newly available variables, you will address important knowledge gaps and explore new research questions in the fields of dialysis and kidney transplantation. You will analyze data and publish your findings in scientific papers that will form the basis of your PhD thesis. By identifying differences between countries, your research may contribute to a better understanding of kidney care across Europe and support country-specific healthcare planning and prioritization. Would you like to know more about the different phases within the PhD trajectory? You can read more about this on this page. You will conduct epidemiological research on patients with kidney disease across European countries, primarily utilizing data from the European Renal Association (ERA) Registry. This is a large European registry that collects data on patients with kidney failure undergoing dialysis or kidney transplantation from around 35 countries across Europe. In addition to your research, you will contribute to the annual data collection of the ERA Registry, and will assist in the publication of the ERA Registry’s annual report and related scientific articles. Currently the team consists of several senior/postdoctoral researchers, three PhD _tudents, a data manager and a management assistant who work intensively together and with nephrologists from different European countries. Throughout your PhD project, you will have the opportunity to fosteryour professional growth by participating in various courses, including those in epidemiology and scientific writing. An MSc degree in the field ofepidemiology, medicine, pharmacy, nutrition, medical informatics or (biomedical) health science A strong motivation to pursue a PhD in epidemiological research Enthusiasm to participate in data collection processes A service-oriented approach to communicating with international partners Proficiency in English, with strong written and oral communication skills A detail-oriented approach to ensure high data quality and scientific accuracy You will be employed by Amsterdam UMC Research BV. A contract for 12 months, with the intention to extend for a total of four years. The Guideline PhD contract applies to this vacancy. jobs.occupation: PhD metabolic footprint in human enterovirus infections along gut-brain axis
jobs.description: Do you want to better understand how viruses affect the human body? Then apply for a PhD position to study the metabolic footprint in human enterovirus infections along the gut-brain axis as part of the MERIT MCSA doctoral network. About the project MERIT (MEtabolic Reprogramming in viral pathogenesis: from Infection to Therapeutic innovations) is an EU-funded MSCA training programme aimed at better understanding how viruses affect the human body. Coordinated by Dr. Adithya Sridhar, Assistant Professor, and Prof. Dr. Dasja Pajkrt, Professor of Pediatric Infectious diseases, from the OrganoVIR Labs at Amsterdam UMC (location AMC), this project brings together 7 academic institutions and 12 associated partners from across Europe. Within MERIT, researchers will take a new, holistic approach that focuses on infections and host metabolism to unravel virus-induced metabolic reprogramming and its impact on human health. The project’s objective lies in understanding the complex interplay between viruses and host cells, focusing on metabolic reprogramming, and long-term consequences of infection. This will be achieved by combining three methodological pillars: human organoids, integrative and spatial omics, and advanced microscopy. About the role Different enteroviruses genotypes exhibit distinct disease presentations, as demonstrated by recent studies using human brain organoids. Clinical differences are associated with differential inflammatory responses, but the underlying metabolic changes driving these varied immune responses remain unexplored. Emerging evidence suggests that enterovirus infections significantly alter the host metabolic landscape, affecting glucose, glutamine, lipid, and nucleotide metabolism. This doctoral project aims to study the hypothesis that early metabolic changes are key determinants of long-term clinical outcomes of enterovirus infections. To test this, the metabolic landscape following infections with enteroviruses belonging to differentspecies will be investigated along the gut-brain axis, with the use of immunocompetent and immunodeficient patient-derived organoids. At the Amsterdam UMC in the Netherlands, MERIT is looking for a Doctoral Candidate (DC) to work on Work Packages 1 and 3. As DC10, your objectives are: to study metabolic changes during infection with enteroviruses belonging to species B and C in gut and brain organoids; to study differences in host responses between immunocompetent and immunodeficient patient gut organoids; to perform integrative omics and genome-scale metabolic modelling for EV-B and EV-C infected organoids. You will be guided during your research project by Dr. Katja Wolthers and Dr. Adithya Sridhar. You can apply for this position until 30 October 2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be considered. Profile master's degree in biomedical sciences, infection, immunity or related fields; experience working with viruses, mammalian cell culture, qPCR, and bioinformatics are preferred; excellent oral and written communication skills in English (minimum C1/C2 CEFR level); an interest in working in a multidisciplinary research group; have not resided/carried out work or studies in the Netherlands for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before 1 April 2027 (transnational mobility rule). Our offer A contract with the Amsterdam UMC for 36 hours per week for 4 years (probation of 6 months). The opportunity to work on large-scale and in-house research with motivated colleagues from all over the world. Planned secondments in the Justus Liebig University Giessen (Germany) and the Medical University Innsbruck (Austria), Training in safety and biosecurity aligned with international best practices. You will be trained in hazard identification, containment, incident reporting, and dual-use/gain-of-function issues. An opportunity to take part in a tailor-made pre-MBA programme to develop entrepreneurial and commercial skills and other network-wide

Would you like to uncover how genetic factors shape brain activity and behaviour? Join the international ENIGMA-EEG consortium and use large-scale genetic and EEG data to investigate brain development and mental health. Genetic factors influence how the brain processes information and regulates behaviour. However, the pathways linking genes to brain function remain poorly understood. In this project, you will investigate the genetic basis of brain activity, focusing on electroencephalographic (EEG) oscillations. These oscillations reflect important processes in communication between brain cells. As part of the international ENIGMA-EEG consortium, you will combine genetic and EEG data to investigate how genes influence brain activity, behavioural traits and mental health. You will identify genetic variants associated with EEG features, explore their effects on brain activity and investigate links between genetic risk factors and neurodevelopment. This interdisciplinary, NWO-funded project brings together large-scale datasets and advanced analytical methods, including machine learning, genomics and transcriptomics. Your research will contribute to identifying new EEG biomarkers for mental health disorders and improving our understanding of brain development from childhood to old age. As a postdoctoral researcher in imaging genetics, you will coordinate data access and integration across the participating ENIGMA-EEG cohorts. You will help develop research projects, communicate with international collaborators and monitor progress across the consortium. Working with researchers from different disciplines, you will analyse large-scale genetic and EEG datasets through meta-analyses. You will translate your findings into scientific publications and conference presentations. You will also contribute to developing protocols and workflows that standardise EEG analyses across cohorts. Your responsibilities include: Coordinating data collection, access and integration acrossparticipating cohorts. Developing research projects in collaboration with international consortium members. Conducting meta-analyses of genetic and EEG data and contributing to scientific publications. Developing and implementing standardised protocols and workflows for EEG analyses. Presenting research findings at scientific conferences and collaborating with researchers across international sites. You will have opportunities to develop your expertise in advanced data analysis methods, including genome-wide association studies (GWAS), polygenic scoring, machine learning, advanced EEG analyses and multi-site statistics. We will support your professional development through training and collaboration with experts in genetics, neuroscience and data analysis. The role also offers opportunities to visit collaborating research groups. You are an enthusiastic and independent researcher who enjoys working across disciplines and collaborating with international research teams. You are interested in the genetic basis of brain function and mental health and are keen to develop your analytical skills. You also have: A PhD in imaging genetics, genetic epidemiology, neuroscience, biological psychology or a related field. A strong interest in the project's research topics and the motivation to engage with ENIGMA-EEG cohort members worldwide. Experience with data analysis using scripting languages or tools such as Bash, Python and/or R. Experience in genetic analysis or physiological data analysis; experience in both is an advantage. Experience implementing neural networks is an advantage. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. You will be employed by Amsterdam UMC Research BV. A 12-month contract, with the intention to extend it for an additional year. Classification in salary scale 10: € 3.724 to € 5.867 gross for full-time employment (depending on experience). In addition to a good basic salary, we offer 8.3% end-of-year bonus. Calculate your net salary

A promising solution is cross-lingual transfer: training models on related languages can improve performance on a target language more effectively than adding more data from the target language itself. The recent ATLAS study (Longpre et al. , 2025) is the largest empirical investigation of this effect to date, training 774 multilingual models across 50 languages and introducing the Bilingual Transfer Score (BTS) to measure how much one language benefits another. jobs.occupation: Sparagus - Principal Architect — OS & System Performance
jobs.description:
The R&D Center of a global leading ICT company, based in Amsterdam.

We are looking for a senior architect to drive the design and development of advanced OS-level system performance technologies and Hardware-software-chip co-optimization for next-generation computing devices.

The role focuses on system scheduling and performance optimization across CPU, GPU, memory, operating system, and chipset layers, balancing performance, power consumption, and thermal constraints. You will work across operating system, Hardware, chipset, runtime, and application layers, driving technologies from architecture and research through implementation and deployment on end devices.
Responsibilities

• Design and develop Hardware-software-chip co-optimization and integrated system scheduling technologies, including CPU/GPU/DDR scheduling, priority management, task grouping, core selection, frequency scaling, resource allocation, and performance/power/thermal-aware scheduling.

• Research and optimize application performance at the OS level, improving application interaction, responsiveness, animation smoothness, and overall system performance.

• Design and optimize high-performance core system modules and resolve critical system performance bottlenecks.

• Research and develop high-performance APIs, runtimes, application frameworks, and performance-oriented system technologies.

• Track advanced industry technologies and academic research and contribute to future technical roadmaps for system performance, scheduling, and Hardware-software co-optimization.

• Drive technical solutions from architecture and research through implementation, validation, and deployment on end devices.

Strong expertise in one or more of the following areas:

• OS or kernel performance optimization

• CPU/GPU/DDR scheduling and system resource management

• Hardware-software or chipset-level co-optimization

• Power- and thermal-aware scheduling and optimization

• Application or runtime performance optimization

• High-performance system, runtime, or framework design

In addition:

• Strong understanding of operating system architecture and system performance fundamentals.

• Hands-on experience identifying and resolving complex system performance bottlenecks.

• Proven ability to deliver measurable performance improvements in real-world systems or products.

• Strong problem-solving and engineering execution capabilities, with the ability to drive solutions from architecture and design through implementation.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively across international research and engineering teams.

Preferred skills:

• Experience with Linux, Android, or other modern operating-system platforms.

• Experience with kernel scheduling, Dvfs/frequency scaling, heterogeneous computing, graphics/GPU systems, memory systems, or chipset-level optimization.

• Experience working across Hardware and software boundaries on complex computing platforms.

• Experience translating research or advanced technical concepts into production-level system technologies.

jobs.occupation: Sparagus - Senior Engineer - AI - Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer in AI-Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling to join a small, highly technical R&D team in Amsterdam.

You will explore and build the next generation of AI-native developer experiences — from intelligent IDE capabilities and coding agents to context-aware, tool-using and self-verifying development workflows.

This is a highly hands-on role with significant technical ownership. You will turn emerging ideas in LLMs, coding agents and developer tooling into working prototypes, evaluate new architectures, and help shape future product direction.
What you'll do

• Build working prototypes and technical demos for AI-native IDE and developer-tooling capabilities.

• Explore how modern coding agents handle context, tool use, planning, orchestration and verification.

• Design and prototype AI-assisted and agentic developer workflows that improve developer productivity and experience.

• Evaluate emerging IDE, LLM and agent architectures hands-on and translate findings into practical technical recommendations.

• Experiment with new approaches to context engineering, agent orchestration and coding-agent evaluation.

• Collaborate with universities, open-source communities, researchers and industry partners.

• Work closely with international R&D teams to influence technical direction and future product capabilities.

What we're looking for

• Strong hands-on experience building IDE, developer-tooling or engineering-productivity features.

• Good understanding of IDE technologies such as IntelliJ Platform, PSI, Lsp, or similar architectures.

• Practical experience with LLMs, coding agents, context engineering, agent orchestration, or evaluation.

• Strong software engineering skills and the ability to independently turn an early-stage idea into a working prototype.

• Strong engineering judgment and ability to evaluate emerging technologies beyond the proof-of-concept stage.

• Strong English communication skills and confidence working with international technical teams.

• Based in Amsterdam or willing to relocate.

Nice to have:

• Experience with compiler toolchains, build systems, runtimes, debugging, or developer test infrastructure.

• Contributions to developer tools, AI coding tools, research projects, or open-source communities.

• Experience building developer tooling for ecosystems with limited documentation, tooling, or training data.

• Experience with code intelligence, code completion, static analysis, refactoring, or program analysis.

• Strong technical communication skills and the ability to clearly explain and advocate for new technical ideas.

Why join?

You'll work at the intersection of AI, IDEs and software engineering, exploring how the next generation of developers will build software with intelligent agents.

Rather than simply integrating existing AI APIs, you'll have the opportunity to experiment, prototype and influence how AI-native development environments are designed from the ground up.

The position is based in Amsterdam and offers a competitive compensation package within an international R&D environment.

We provide control, predictability and better financial accountability. - Contact us directly Projects run over budget or returns lag behind? This is often due to insufficient insight into the relationship between progress, costs and planning. With good cost control you can avoid financial surprises and make timely adjustments. What is cost control and why is it crucial? Cost control, or cost management, is the process of monitoring, analyzing and adjusting project costs against budget. It is closely related to cost management: the broader set of financial control within projects. Well-organized cost control makes project costs predictable, controllable and accountable to the client, management and board. Especially in technical or long-term projects, this is essential to maintain trust, both internally and externally. cost control  How does cost control work within project organizations? Effective cost control starts with a reasoned budget, but it doesn't stop there. Throughout the project, we continue to test continuously: - How far along are we really in implementation? - What have we spent so far? - How does this compare with the original budget and schedule? - Do we need to make adjustments, and if so, where and when? We set up processes and reports in such a way that you have real-time insight into these dynamics. Not explaining afterwards, but signaling beforehand.  Earned Value Management (EVM): measuring = knowing Earned Value Management (EVM) is a widely used methodology within cost control. It links three dimensions together: - Budget (planned value) - Actual cost - Progress/performance (earned value). By monitoring these integrally, you gain early insight into deviations and trends. Are you an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and discovering why products sometimes fail? Do you like combining analytical thinking with hands-on troubleshooting? You will work at the intersection of engineering, quality and production. Your analysis will not only help solve individual failures, but also contribute to making future products more reliable. jobs.description: Join Albert Heijn Online in Eindhoven as a delivery driver. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21, with part-time and full-time opportunities. Wat bieden wij? The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Development and career opportunities within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Eindhoven As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Eindhoven, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders safely and on time. At the beginning of your shift, you prepare for your assigned route. You check what you need for the day, get into the delivery van and use navigation to drive to your first customer. At each address, you select the correct order from the van and carry the grocery crates to the customer's front door. You provide friendly service and make sure the groceries are handed over carefully. If there are empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Once everything is taken care of, you continue to the next customer. Your working day is a combination of driving, physical activity and customer contact. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' doors and lift grocery crates. At the same time, you have plenty of independence while completing your route through Eindhoven and the surrounding area. After your final delivery, you return to the location, complete your route and leave the van ready for the next shift. Do I need previous experience as a delivery driver? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver, courier or professional driver is not required. When you start, you will receipractical training. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague and learn how the job works before completing routes independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM. Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I need to work on Saturdays? You do not have to work every Saturday. However, you must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. Driving is only one part of your working day. You will regularly lift and carry grocery crates, walk between the delivery van and customers' doors and get in and out of the vehicle throughout your route. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Eindhoven You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed working hours. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Previous delivery experience is not required. Would you like to combine driving with an active and varied job in Eindhoven? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

jobs.description: - Werken bij Vanderlande - Evenementen  - URL copied  Werkgebied  Locatie  Veghel, Netherlands.  Contract type  Full time  - URL copied Assignment type : Graduation Start date : February 2026 Assignmentduration : 6 months Location : Veghel Educationlevel : Bachelor Desiredstudy : Mechatronics & electrical engineering, mechanical engineering & applied physics, software engineering & embedded systems Language : Dutch / English Description of assignment At Vanderlande, we serve customers worldwide by building highly flexible material handling systems out of configurable building blocks. To drive these systems, our Model Based Design (MBD) workflow uses tools like MATLAB/Simulink to develop and test controllers in virtual environments before generating code for various PLC platforms (such as Siemens PLC, Allen-Bradley PLC, and C++). While automated code generation enables versatile deployment, it often makes the generated code unreadable for controls engineers on customer sites, leaving them heavily reliant on basic interface statistics during troubleshooting. In this hands-on project, you will explore new ways to make control software transparent and accessible for site engineers. Focusing on solutions like Simatic Target for Simulink, you will investigate how engineers can deploy generated code while maintaining visual access to the original model. You will analyze current MBD workflows, test new tools on existing OT modules, and evaluate how this way of working improves debugging efficiency and commissioning on site. jobs.description: Join Albert Heijn Online in Amersfoort as a delivery driver. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21, with part-time and full-time options. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The option to receive your salary weekly or every four weeks. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training before you start working independently. Support from an experienced colleague during your first working days. Opportunities to develop within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amersfoort As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you make sure online grocery orders reach customers in Amersfoort and the surrounding area. At the beginning of your shift, you check the route planned for you and prepare for departure. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel and drive to your first customer. At each stop, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You hand over the groceries carefully and provide friendly service. If the customer has empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Then it is time for the next address. This makes every shift a combination of driving and physical activity. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' doors and carry grocery crates. At the same time, you have the freedom and responsibility of completing your route independently. Once all orders have been delivered, you return to the location in Amersfoort and complete your shift. Do I need previous experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier is not required. When you start, you will receive practical training and can join an experienced colleague during your first working days. This helps you become familiar with the job beforedriving routes independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Is Saturday availability mandatory? Yes. You need to be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. What does a typical shift involve? You drive between customers, deliver their grocery orders and provide friendly service at the door. The role also involves regular physical activity, including lifting grocery crates, walking to customers' homes and getting in and out of the delivery van throughout your shift. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amersfoort You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Would you like an active driving job in Amersfoort? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. Tasks, salary, and working through Charlie works  30 September 2026 4 min read What exactly does a logistics worker do? Do you want to know what a logistics worker does before you start working in the Netherlands? In short, a logistics worker ensures that products end up in the right place. This starts with unloading trucks and ends with preparing orders for shipment. A lot happens in between: scanning, sorting, packing, and sometimes driving a pallet truck or forklift. The job is physical, varied, and very suitable if you enjoy working with your hands. You do not need a diploma, and basic English or Polish is often sufficient on the work floor. That is why this is a popular first job for migrant workers from Poland, Hungary, Slovakia, and Romania. What is a logistics worker? A logistics worker usually works in a warehouse or distribution center. You are part of a team that manages the flow of goods. Think of large centers for webshops, supermarkets, or transport companies. There are thousands of these types of locations in the Netherlands, especially around Venlo, Tilburg, Rotterdam, and Utrecht. The role is broad. One day you pick orders, the next you help in the packing department or check the stock. Do you want to know more about what such a location looks like from the inside? Then read our article about working in a distribution center in the Netherlands . jobs.description: Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Amsterdam. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21 and choose part-time or full-time hours. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice of weekly or four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to ride along with an experienced colleague during your first working days. Opportunities to develop within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. A €150 net Bring a Friend bonus, subject to the applicable conditions. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam Your working day starts at the Albert Heijn Online Home Shop Center at Beiraweg 6 in Amsterdam. Before leaving, you check your route and prepare the delivery van for the shift ahead. Once everything is ready, you head out to deliver groceries to customers throughout Amsterdam and the surrounding area. At every stop, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's door. You make sure the order is delivered carefully and provide friendly service during the handover. Empty crates may also need to be taken back with you. Then you continue to your next address. Driving is an important part of the position, but you will also spend plenty of time on your feet. Getting in and out of the van, walking to customers' doors and lifting grocery crates are all part of a normal working day. The routes take you through different parts of Amsterdam and the surrounding area, so your surroundings and customers change throughout the day. After completing your final delivery, you return to Beiraweg 6, finish your route and leave the van ready for the next shift. Do I need previous delivery experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courieris not required. You will receive training when you start, and during your first working days you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the job in practice before driving routes independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I have to work on Saturdays? You need to be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is the job physically demanding? The position involves regular physical activity. You will carry grocery crates, walk between the delivery van and customers' doors and get in and out of the vehicle throughout your shift. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed working hours. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Interested in working on the road in Amsterdam? Apply through Consolid for the position of Delivery Driver at Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

Training Information WHY THE NEN 9140 TRAINING FOR WORKSHOP SUPERVISOR In electric vehicles, the propulsion system operates at high voltages. These can pose a danger to people who have to work on these vehicles. The employer is responsible for the safety of the staff. This must ensure a safe workplace and the correct instruction of the staff. For example, an occupational health and safety officer can help with this. The EV workshop supervisor (EV-WV) is the one who is actually in charge of the work on e-vehicles. In this e-learning you will learn what the NEN 9140 standard entails and what the standard regulates for those who work on e-vehicles in the workshop. You can see which employees are allowed to perform certain activities and how the designation policy works. You will learn about personal protective equipment and tools, and the usefulness and necessity of instruction and training. HOW IS THE TRAINING STRUCTURED? jobs.description: Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Oosterhout, Gelderland. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in and work 12-32 hours per week. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. 25 vacation days based on full-time employment. Pension accrual. Travel allowance. A flexible position for 12 to 32 hours per week. The opportunity to submit your own availability. Shifts from Monday through Sunday. Morning, afternoon and evening shifts. Practical training with an experienced buddy. Employee discount through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Opportunities to develop within the role, for example by becoming a buddy for new drivers. An active job with plenty of variety and time on the road. Opportunities for long-term employment through Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Oosterhout, Gelderland Your working day starts at the Albert Heijn Online location at Linie 11 in Oosterhout, Gelderland. Here, you collect the keys to your delivery van, check the route for your shift and get ready to head out. Once on the road, navigation guides you from one customer to the next. Your route can take you through Oosterhout and other places in the surrounding area, so every shift can look a little different. When you arrive at an address, you select the correct grocery order from the van and check it using a handheld scanner. You then carry the crates to the customer's front door and make sure the order is handed over correctly. Customer contact is an important part of the job. You greet customers in a friendly way, help with questions when necessary and process payments if required. Empty crates and returnable packaging can also be collected before you continue your route. After completing the delivery, you get back behind the wheel and head to the next address. Although driving is a major part of the role, you will not spend your entire shift sitting down. You regularly get in and out of tvan, walk to customers' doors and lift grocery crates. This makes the job a good combination of driving, physical activity and customer service. Once you have completed your final delivery, you return to Linie 11. You finish your route, return the necessary equipment and leave the delivery van ready for the next shift. Do I need experience as a delivery driver? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier is not required. During your first working days, you will be trained by an experienced buddy. You will learn how to use the delivery van, handheld scanner and systems, as well as how to deliver orders and deal with different situations at the customer's door. Once you are familiar with the job, you can start driving your routes independently. Can I submit my own availability? Yes. You can let us know when you are available, and this will be taken into account when the schedule is created. You can work between 12 and 32 hours per week. For this position, you need to be available for at least two shifts per week and at least two Saturdays per month. What does a typical shift involve? You start at Linie 11, collect your van and check your route. You then drive to the customers scheduled for your shift. At each stop, you scan and deliver the groceries, help the customer when needed and collect empty crates. After your final delivery, you return to the location and complete your shift. Can I develop within this role? Yes. Once you have gained experience, there are opportunities to take on additional responsibilities. For example, you may become a buddy and help train new delivery drivers during their first working days.
